description: Akrou protest on 18 Oct is confirmed by KOACI and Yessouan, but neither reports attendance. APA wording is origin-ambiguous (AP/APA) and AbidjanTV has date/provenance concerns; no >=50 evidence accepted.

description: Health/education work stoppage is reported 15–17 Oct, including closures in Abidjan and Bouaké, but no public picket/rally or same-place count is recorded in opened accounts.
required_followup: Search a permitted source for actual picketing, a union assembly or demonstration during 15–17 Oct; do not sum school absences across sites.

description: November sources found retrospective reports on the 18 Oct Akrou episode but do not establish a new November gathering or resolved end date.
